paragraphs: Rabbi Hoshaya, son of Rabbi Simlai of Caesarea, in Rabbi Yitzchak bar Ze'ira’s name, Rabbah, Emor, section 31. Yuchasin lists Rabbi Shimi of Caesarea as Rabbi Hoshaya’s father. I did not find it; this appears an error for Rabbi Simlai of Caesarea.
